digest_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and domain-separated schema/version name unless a tranche acceptance authority defines a stricter binary composition

campaign_generation.conflict_behavior: different membership/order/holds under same ID fails closed
campaign_generation.consumer_validation: recompute counts, finding uniqueness, order, DAG, schemas, proposed/active state, and holds
campaign_generation.currentness_rule: latest explicitly activated and accepted campaign generation, not this proposal
campaign_generation.digest_composition: canonical program authority, ordered tranche identities/dependencies, schema digests, and baseline/hold digests
campaign_generation.external_pending: final campaign may preserve external-pending tranches but cannot report released gates
campaign_generation.missing_behavior: no active campaign is inferred from a proposal or documentation tree
campaign_generation.owner: S0 admission authority and final T43 campaign closure authority
campaign_generation.persistence_boundary: immutable admission/result receipt; mutable task documents remain separate authority until explicitly updated
campaign_generation.replay_rule: same authority inputs reproduce same campaign digest
campaign_generation.supersession_rule: new campaign generation references predecessor and explicit authorization

config_generation.clock_authority: admission/receipt clock; no config file mtime authority
config_generation.conflict_behavior: same ID with different effective values/source labels fails closed
config_generation.consumer_validation: validate explicit source precedence, required fields, blank handling, destination confinement, and secret-safe digest
config_generation.currentness_rule: exact config_generation named by the admitted process/campaign
config_generation.digest_composition: domain-separated canonical key/source/blank-state map; secrets represented only by approved one-way digests or presence metadata
config_generation.external_pending: not a substitute for missing internal configuration
config_generation.missing_behavior: no default, environment fallback, or blank coercion unless the reviewed contract explicitly permits it
config_generation.owner: T37/T38 and the active tranche owning each explicit configuration contract
config_generation.persistence_boundary: receipt only; raw secrets and credentials are never persisted
config_generation.replay_rule: reconstruct equivalent non-secret map from approved protected configuration source
config_generation.supersession_rule: new generation references prior config generation and reason

environment_generation.clock_authority: environment runner and external source clocks recorded separately
environment_generation.conflict_behavior: wrong target, stale source, synthetic substitution, or different evidence under same ID blocks
environment_generation.consumer_validation: prove correct lane, target, isolation, lineage, bounded operation, evidence, and cleanup
environment_generation.currentness_rule: environment receipt matches exact postimage and required proof lane
environment_generation.digest_composition: canonical environment inventory plus consumed generations, proof result, evidence and cleanup hashes
environment_generation.external_pending: allowed only for explicitly required unavailable external upstream acceptance, retained as non-promotable
environment_generation.missing_behavior: unknown/missing environment identity, cleanup, external authority, or result blocks
environment_generation.owner: proof-lane operator and tranche acceptance reviewer
environment_generation.persistence_boundary: immutable environment-proof receipt; raw credentials excluded
environment_generation.replay_rule: disposable proof can be rebuilt from declared non-secret contract; managed soak resumes from accepted checkpoint
environment_generation.supersession_rule: new environment result references prior result and reason for rerun

evidence_generation.clock_authority: producer monotonic/wall clocks and publication clock recorded distinctly
evidence_generation.conflict_behavior: same identity/different content or broken reference blocks publication
evidence_generation.consumer_validation: recompute content digest, verify producer lineage, schema, reference graph, currentness, and redaction
evidence_generation.currentness_rule: monotonic accepted pointer bound to exact generation, never filename mtime alone
evidence_generation.digest_composition: canonical metadata plus exact immutable content bytes and sorted references
evidence_generation.external_pending: may record unavailable accepted external evidence without promoting gates
evidence_generation.missing_behavior: missing artifact, digest, producer, reference, or redaction proof is failure
evidence_generation.owner: T26-T29 with producing tranche owner for domain-specific evidence
evidence_generation.persistence_boundary: content-addressed immutable objects with serialized create-or-compare indexes
evidence_generation.replay_rule: same inputs reproduce byte-identical evidence or an explicitly versioned semantic equivalent
evidence_generation.supersession_rule: new evidence retains predecessor/reference links and cannot delete accepted dependencies

process_generation.clock_authority: database/monotonic process clock as specified by accepted lifecycle contract; wall clock recorded separately
process_generation.conflict_behavior: two live owners or non-monotonic heartbeat/epoch blocks and self-fences
process_generation.consumer_validation: prove owner before side effects, exact executable, fencing epoch, child ownership, and terminality
process_generation.currentness_rule: highest accepted fencing epoch with live owner proof and matching source/config
process_generation.external_pending: not permitted for missing internal ownership proof
process_generation.missing_behavior: unknown owner/child/terminal state is failure, not readiness
process_generation.owner: T21-T25 for runtime processes; T44-T47 for controller processes
process_generation.persistence_boundary: durable lifecycle receipt/checkpoint; PID files alone are not authority
process_generation.replay_rule: restart reconciles durable state and does not infer success from stale PID/heartbeat
process_generation.supersession_rule: new fenced owner explicitly supersedes terminal/stale prior generation

release_generation.clock_authority: release receipt clock; filesystem mtime is metadata only
release_generation.conflict_behavior: partial publication or same ID/different bytes leaves release blocked
release_generation.consumer_validation: independently re-read archive, reject undeclared/missing members, validate runtime and predecessor, prove atomic publication
release_generation.currentness_rule: explicit accepted publication receipt, not mutable singleton archive presence
release_generation.digest_composition: canonical exact member inventory plus consumed generation IDs and plan digest
release_generation.external_pending: source-complete release proof cannot release external runtime holds
release_generation.missing_behavior: unknown runtime, component, archive, rollback, or publication state blocks
release_generation.owner: T33/T34/T36; separate release decision owner retains hold authority
release_generation.parent_generation: accepted source/config/process/evidence generations and prior release generation
release_generation.persistence_boundary: immutable archive generation and atomic current pointer after all targets commit
release_generation.replay_rule: same member bytes/modes and parents reproduce same release digest
release_generation.supersession_rule: new release preserves accepted predecessor and rollback path

source_generation.clock_authority: receipt clock plus source-origin/receive/verify clocks kept distinct
source_generation.conflict_behavior: same identity with different bytes or parents fails closed
source_generation.consumer_validation: recompute all available hashes; reject omitted, extra, mismatched, stale, or wrong-parent members
source_generation.currentness_rule: latest explicitly accepted descendant of the admitted parent, never newest filename alone
source_generation.digest_composition: domain-separated canonical encoding of repository identity, parent source generation, sorted path/mode/content hashes, and accepted upstream source receipts
source_generation.external_pending: permitted only when local source is complete but accepted external upstream evidence remains unavailable
source_generation.owner: T40 for BWS repository source authority; T02/T03 for upstream object/API source sub-generations
source_generation.parent_generation: prior accepted source_generation or BWS122 baseline
source_generation.persistence_boundary: immutable receipt and content-addressed evidence; mutable convenience pointers are non-authoritative
source_generation.replay_rule: same bytes, modes, identity fields, and parent produce the same digest
source_generation.supersession_rule: new accepted generation references predecessor; predecessor remains addressable

test_generation.clock_authority: test runner start/end clock with monotonic duration
test_generation.conflict_behavior: same test generation ID with different command/result blocks
test_generation.consumer_validation: command actually executed, bounded, correct runtime/environment, production-entrypoint flag satisfied, output/evidence present
test_generation.currentness_rule: receipt postimage/source IDs match the tranche postimage being accepted
test_generation.digest_composition: canonical command, inputs, runtime/environment, test source bytes, result/status, and evidence hashes
test_generation.external_pending: not used to excuse internal tests
test_generation.missing_behavior: not run, timeout, skipped, wrong runtime, missing output, or stale postimage does not pass
test_generation.owner: active tranche owner; independent acceptance reviewer verifies production-entrypoint binding
test_generation.persistence_boundary: immutable focused/production-entrypoint test receipts; test listing is non-evidence
test_generation.replay_rule: same inputs rerunnable in declared disposable/controlled environment; nondeterminism is explicit failure or versioned tolerance
test_generation.supersession_rule: rerun receipt references prior failed/stale receipt and same/new postimage

tranche_generation.conflict_behavior: multiple admitted source-mutating tranches or changed membership/owner blocks
tranche_generation.consumer_validation: verify exactly one admission, dependency terminal states, path boundary, preimage, proof, and allowed transition
tranche_generation.currentness_rule: the single explicitly admitted non-terminal tranche; all others are NOT_ADMITTED or terminal
tranche_generation.digest_composition: canonical admission plus preimage, finding, dependency, path, test/environment, and hold identities
tranche_generation.external_pending: only campaign-map-marked T29/T36 may use SOURCE_COMPLETE_EXTERNAL_PENDING
tranche_generation.missing_behavior: no source mutation without complete admission; unknown state fails closed
tranche_generation.owner: the campaign-map primary owner for the exactly admitted tranche
tranche_generation.parent_generation: campaign_generation and predecessor accepted tranche postimage/result
tranche_generation.persistence_boundary: immutable admission and terminal result receipts
tranche_generation.replay_rule: retry starts from same preimage or a new explicitly reconciled admission
tranche_generation.supersession_rule: replacement admission references revoked/blocked predecessor and explains source change

secret_policy: raw secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, passwords, and unredacted protected configuration are prohibited in identities and receipts
